name: OmaTablePlus
author: BlackCode
description: OmaTablePlus: a TablePlus-style database app for Omarchy, in its own window with a launcher entry. Browse, edit and query PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Redis, Valkey and MongoDB, directly or through SSH, with your OmaDBngin servers listed automatically

barWidget.description: Opens the OmaTablePlus app; a dot shows while it runs. Right-click: new window
